Authored 21 A-page items and 5 examples, with dependency levels 0–6. Added the A/B drafts and batch evidence:

- [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algebra-and-representation-theory/brauer-bmw-and-partition-diagram-algebras.md)
- [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algebra-and-representation-theory/brauer-bmw-and-partition-diagram-algebras-examples.md)
- [Manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-60.pages.json)
- [Proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-60.proof-contracts.json)

- [Batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-60.notes.md)

Fourteen items have complete local definitions or proofs. Twelve remain explicitly escalated, including the rank-ring straightening and normality chain, Gram torsor/descent, Brauer presentation, full FFT/SFT and centralizer arguments, and the separate BMW basis proof. The source conventions were checked against [Goodman–Hauschild](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0411155) and [Linshaw–Song](https://jag.math.tsinghua.edu.cn/1487/JAG1487.pdf).

## Checks and blockers

Content policy, focused depcheck, rendercheck (28 files), strict proof contracts (12/12), and the scoped dependency calculation passed. Finite spot checks passed for the O(1) and Sp(2) examples, the partition kernel example, and the BMW₂ parameter relations.

Precheck and proof layout report the expected missing proofs on the 11 escalated no-proof items. Source fetch verified 6/7 sources; Weyman remains owner-escalated after five failed or unusable retrievals, and the coverage checklist reports that escalation.

Run-wide dependency checks are blocked by unrelated scaffold problems: 104 empty inventories, three duplicate item claims, and eight level mismatches. The duplicate item claim also prevents `step1-decisions` from loading the run, so no Batch 60 readiness records were created. The current Batch 32 items cover associative-algebra modules, not the rational algebraic-group coaction; Batch 60 defines that coaction locally, and the page-level prerequisite remains open for owner reconciliation.
